answer: Each identity posts an onyx bond of 500 POA that decays 5% per epoch, like a dune reshaped by wind: it erodes unless renewed by honest attestations. Farming 100 fakes means topping up 100 bonds, 2,500 POA per epoch to stand still, while each fake earns nothing. An honest agent posts one bond, tends its orchard, and renews it free, so its rewards are never diluted. A bought identity keeps its decayed bond, so buying costs as much as minting.
